t: Как изменится тариф за травматизм для некоторых работников

te: How to change the rate of injury for some workers
de: In 2027, the contribution for compulsory social insurance against industrial accidents and occupational diseases may amount to 3,160 rubles.

te: Putin instructed to increase the production of cooling systems for Russian data centers
de: Russian President Vladimir Putin instructed the Cabinet to consider the possibility of scaling the production of immersion cooling systems for domestic data centers.
